brief:
NFL player Azeez Al-Shaair paid tribute to another Palestinian child killed by Israel, according to Al Jazeera English, continuing his commemoration despite facing a league fine the previous week.

The Houston Texans linebacker's gesture marks his second public honouring of Palestinian casualties. His earlier tribute drew an NFL penalty, yet Al-Shaair proceeded with the latest tribute to the deceased girl.
dek: Azeez Al-Shaair has paid tribute to another Palestinian child killed by Israel, despite the NFL fine last week.
title: NFL player Al-Shaair honours slain Palestinian girl despite league fine
